mapper.select: SELECT RI.ROOM_IMG_SN, RI.ROOM_SN, RI.ATCH_FILE_SN, RI.SORT_SEQ, RI.RPRS_YN, A.URL_ADDR, A.ORGNL_FILE_NM FROM ROOM_IMAGE RI JOIN ATCH_FILE A ON A.ATCH_FILE_SN = RI.ATCH_FILE_SN WHERE RI.ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND RI.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY RI.SORT_SEQ, RI.ROOM_IMG_SN
SELECT ROOM_IMG_SN, ROOM_SN, ATCH_FILE_SN, SORT_SEQ, RPRS_YN, DEL_YN FROM ROOM_IMAGE WHERE ROOM_IMG_SN = #{roomImgSn} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(SORT_SEQ), 0) FROM ROOM_IMAGE WHERE ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM_IMAGE WHERE ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT ROOM_IMG_SN FROM ROOM_IMAGE WHERE ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ, ROOM_IMG_SN LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ROOM_IMAGE SET RPRS_YN = 'N', MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND RPRS_YN = 'Y'
